title: Ehsaas Scholarship Cheque Distribution
text:
Ehsaas Scholarship Cheque Distribution

It is notified for the information of the following
EUSP awardees
that you may collect your cheques from

Directorate of Admissions (PCA Building)
on

Thursday to Friday (17
th
and 18
th
July, 2025)
.

NOTE: Please bring the following documents for collection of cheque:

Transcript and clearance copy
(if passed out)

CNIC copy

Student Card copy

Award letter

Academic Progress Report
(
